summary: 3D vector cross product (fastcall): computes a1 x a2 and stores the three components into the output vector a3, returning a3. Component x = a2[2]*a1[1] - a2[1]*a1[2], y = a2[0]*a1[2] - a2[2]*a1[0], z = a2[1]*a1[0] - a2[0]*a1[1]. Pure math helper with no guards, globals or nested calls.

operations.description: Compute the x component of a1 x a2: v6 = a2[2]*a1[1] - a2[1]*a1[2].
Compute the y component of a1 x a2: v7 = a2[0]*a1[2] - a2[2]*a1[0].
Compute the z component of a1 x a2: v8 = (a2[1]*a1[0]) - (a2[0]*a1[1]).
Store the x component into the output vector: a3[0] = v6.
Store the y component into the output vector: a3[1] = v7.
Store the z component into the output vector: a3[2] = v8.
Return the output vector pointer a3 (result).
Used by VehicleGeometryProximityTest (0x004ED420), sub_4EE2D0 (0x004EE2D0) and RayTriangleIntersectionWithBarycentricCoordinate (0x004EFBD0) for geometric cross products.
